JANSNO X50 Fat Tire Electric Bike for Adults

Your Every Day Companion

Value, Experience, and Safety in Off-Road Adventure, these three words are more than just values—they define our commitment to creating innovative off-road cycling solutions with an adventurous spirit. The Jansno X50 is not just another disposable toy; it's built to last, providing exceptional value, unparalleled riding experience, and utmost safety for every adventure seeker.

We believe everyone should have the opportunity to own an exceptional electric bike without breaking the bank. The X50 offers top-tier features at an unbeatable price.

We are thrilled to introduce a bike that reflects our dedication to quality, innovation, and affordability. The Jansno X50 is more than just a bike; it’s a statement of our commitment to providing the best experience for riders.

Explore the Jansno X50 today and discover why it is the perfect choice for off-road enthusiasts seeking a budget-friendly, feature-packed electric bike. Jansno makes high-quality electric bikes accessible to everyone.

Ride Green

Driving in the city has become pointless—expensive, congested, stressful, and polluting. Fast, economical, and clean electric bikes are the perfect urban alternative to cars.

JANSNO X50 offers the performance of an electric motorcycle, allowing you to navigate city streets, climb steep outdoor hills, and reach the outskirts of town without spending a dime on gasoline.

You can pedal for exercise whenever you want, or if you're tired, ride up hills at speeds of up to 28 mph with just a throttle twist!

With JANSNO, you can do all this while promoting a cleaner environment. Whether commuting to work, exploring outdoor adventures, or simply enjoying a leisurely ride, our electric bikes help you effortlessly contribute to a sustainable future.

Join the JANSNO eco-revolution and ride towards a greener tomorrow.

What does a 12-year-old look like on a bike?

Look good too!!!

Keep it stylish

The Jansno X50 combines modern and classic elements in its design, Its streamlined profile and sturdy build not only ensure stability and reliability but also exuding a robust off-road vibe.

Conquer Any Terrain and Smooth Ride

Experience unparalleled versatility with the Jansno X50's advanced front suspension system. From rocky trails to uneven terrain, it absorbs bumps and shocks for a controlled ride. Built to handle off-road challenges, it delivers stability and comfort with every pedal stroke. Gear up and unleash your spirit of adventure with the Jansno X50, where performance meets precision on any trail.

Let's Dive into Adventure!

Put maximum power behind your daily adventure with the 1000w engine that is optimized to a driver's industry-leading torque of 60Nm. Push the motor to the max, and with the 7-speed Shimano powertrain, conquer hills with ease!

Long-Distance Performance

The X50 comes with a removable 48V 17Ah battery and has a range of up to 80 KM in pedal assist mode. Ideal for extended adventures, it ensures you can explore further without having to worry about running out of power.

Effortless Control

The brake system of the Jansno Bike features front and rear Shimano mechanical disc brakes, including levers and calipers, for smooth and controlled braking with less effort and more fingertip control.

Whether you're seeking thrills off-road or cruising through the city, the X50 ensures a high rate of return on excitement.

Puncture-Resistant Wide Tires

Jansno bikes are equipped with 4.0 x 20.0" puncture-resistant wide tires. These tires are designed to withstand punctures and provide enhanced stability and grip on various terrains, ensuring a smoother and safer riding experience.

Bright headlights, Turn signals, Taillight.

Ensuring visibility in low light conditions or when entering a tunnel contributes to safer driving.

They make your outdoor exercise and commute safer.

Clear and Intuitive Data Support

Get full transparency during the "status" of your ride on the smart display with NFC. The waterproof display gives you a full-ride report after each ride.
- 1-7 pedal assist level
- Speed
- Battery
- Distance

Pedal assists up to 7 levels on a bright screen. The bright screen will show you all the details you need.

JANSNO X50 Earns Rider Accolades Worldwide

DIY Galore! Perfect for extreme sports, commuters, students, RV owners, boat owners, resort living, and more.

The Jansno X50 will be fully compliant with EU e-bike regulations - the speed limit is 15.5mph, - and we are CE/UL certified.

For off-road riders, we can also unlock the speed limit, which can be obtained by email.
